_note: 版式槽位说明:AI 只需要给每个槽一个取数表达式或一句文案,写进 .df 的「① 槽位」。坐标、配色、数字格式化、空态都由版式负责。maxLen 按档位给,单位是中文字数(英文约 1.8 倍字符),超出会以「…」截断。

summary.zh-CN: 最近每天做没做:方形 7×5(35 天),宽档 7×15(105 天),右下角是今天
summary.en-US: Did it happen each day: 7×5 (35 days) square, 7×15 (105 days) wide; bottom-right is today

pick.zh-CN: 习惯、运动、喝水、学习这类按天记的事
pick.en-US: Habits, workouts, water, study — anything logged per day

meaning.zh-CN: 组件名(第一行):有对象写对象名,没有就写功能名
meaning.en-US: Widget name (first line): the object's name, or what it shows

meaning.zh-CN: 按天的 0 / 1 串,从旧到新,最后一位 = 今天(1 = 做了)。长度不限,取最后 35 / 105 位,不够的按没做补
meaning.en-US: A string of 0/1 per day, oldest first, last char = today (1 = done). Any length; the last 35 / 105 are used, missing days count as not done

meaning.zh-CN: 源色:身份点与强调色。只选名字;财经涨跌类用 graphite(红绿已被涨跌占用)
meaning.en-US: Accent: the identity dot and highlight colour. Pick a name; use graphite for up/down finance widgets (red/green already mean up/down)
